look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST — Acalypha radians: low spreading to ascending PERENNIAL, often in deep sand, with small, rounded or kidney-shaped leaves whose edges are deeply CRENATE (rounded scallops). Species is DIOECIOUS: male and female flowers occur on different plants, never presume an individual female cluster proves this alone. Female spikes have very CROWDED bracts with axis hidden between them, typically 8–10 SPOON-SHAPED (spatulate) lobes, extending about half the bract length, and many-branched styles. Versus A. phleoides: erect perennial with more pointed serrate ovate leaves and terminal MIXED (lower female, upper male) spikes with spaced triangular bracts; versus A. persimilis: broad heart-based leaves and annual habit, many narrow bract lobes.

morphology_keys.comparison_training: Acalypha phleoides is monoecious with a terminal bisexual spike; A. persimilis is annual and has different reproductive architecture.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Acalypha radians: Kidney-like deeply scalloped leaves; dioecious and crowded female bracts; 8–10 spatulate lobes | Acalypha phleoides: Erect perennial, pointed leaves, mixed terminal spike; 5–7 triangular lobes, spaced bracts | Acalypha persimilis / ostryifolia: Taller annual with larger heart-based serrate leaves and mostly 13–17 narrow female bract lobes | Acalypha monostachya (look-alike only): Smaller rounded leaves but shallower scallops and female bract lobes only about quarter length; species-concept/range not assessed here

photo_diagnostic_lesson.title: Cardinal feather — deeply scalloped leaves and crowded female bracts

steps.what: Check soil-level sprawling or ascending growth; do not confuse with an erect shrubby copperleaf.
Photograph leaf face from above; use scale for typical 0.5–1.5 cm blades.
Find a pistillate spike: crowded bracts with about 8–10 broad spoonlike lobes extending roughly halfway.
Compare separate flowering plants; a single female branch cannot prove dioecy.
Acalypha monostachya look-alike has shallower leaf scallops and shorter female bract lobes.

photo_diagnostic_lesson.memory_rule: Spreading perennial branches → Kidney shaped + deep rounded scallops → Overlapping bracts hide flowering axis
